startup.label: live gVisor + 0.6 s published gap
startup.source: Li et al., CLOSER 2021, §3.1.1/Fig. 3: Kata-FC 0.50 s slower than gVisor, Kata-QEMU a further 0.10 s (Kata 1.11, same host). https://www.scitepress.org/Papers/2021/104405/104405.pdf

density.source: Li et al., CLOSER 2021, Fig. 4: Kata-QEMU 137.6 MB per container, avg of 100, private dirty pages (gVisor 10.3 MB in the same study). https://www.scitepress.org/Papers/2021/104405/104405.pdf

checkpoint.status: not supported: "The runtime does not provide checkpoint and restore commands."

hardware.note: Kata needs KVM. GCP: nested virtualization is off by default and unavailable on E2, Arm and most AMD VMs. AWS: non-metal support only since 2026-02, on some instance types. Azure: blocked by Trusted Launch, the default.
